purpose: Permanent source-memory additions for African, Asian, European and Latin-American local-language Islamic book discovery.

sources.name: Muslim Library — Swahili
sources.role: Swahili Islamic books and translations; Sunnah-oriented discovery

sources.name: Islamic Foundation Bangladesh
sources.role: official Islamic publications, Quran, tafsir, hadith and encyclopedia in Bengali

sources.name: El-Kalem — Islamic Community in Bosnia and Herzegovina publishing
sources.role: Bosnian Islamic publishing and heritage discovery

sources.name: Japan Islamic Trust
sources.role: Japanese Muslim education, Quran/Hadith classes and multilingual Islamic library discovery

sources.name: Japan Islamic Association — Publications
sources.role: Japanese Islamic publications and bibliographic discovery

sources.name: Korea Muslim Federation
sources.role: Korean Islamic literature, translation and publication discovery

sources.name: The Clear Publishing — Spanish Editions
sources.role: Spanish Quran editions and book discovery

verification_notes: Muslim Library currently exposes a dedicated Swahili catalogue with thousands of multilingual Islamic books and numerous Swahili titles.
Islamic Foundation Bangladesh has an official publications catalogue covering Quran/tafsir, hadith, seerah and Islamic encyclopedia subjects.
Japan Islamic Trust is a registered Japanese organization and its site documents a multilingual Islamic library at Otsuka Mosque plus Quran/Hadith education.
Japan Islamic Association maintains a publications page for Japanese Islamic scholarship and books.
The Clear Publishing has a dedicated Spanish Editions catalogue for Quran publications.
Korea Muslim Federation is retained as a discovery source; independent official-domain verification should precede acquisition automation.

User-supplied claims about local-language Sunni publishing are preserved as discovery leads, while religious/sectarian characterization is not treated as an automatic legal or editorial certification.
required_behavior: Search saved local-language sources before generic web rediscovery.
Keep each language as an independent search lane: Swahili, Wolof, Bambara, Bengali, Maranao/Tagalog, Bosnian, Albanian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Portuguese.
Preserve provenance and item-level rights; discoverability does not imply redistribution permission.
Append future national, university, mosque, publisher and Islamic-library sources rather than replacing prior entries.
